tool.help:
.. class:: infomark See pandas documentation: https://pandas.pydata.org/docs/ for full software details.
**What it does** Counts how often every identification occurs at every taxonomic rank, for every file or sample in the input. The output is an Excel file with one sheet for every rank, from kingdom to species.
The input is a single BLAST file, an OTU file with old or new BLAST output, an OTU file with LCA output, or a list collection of BLAST files. Each file in a collection becomes a column, named after its element identifier followed by ".tabular". Characters other than letters, digits, dots, underscores and hyphens become underscores. Numeric suffixes distinguish names that would otherwise collide.
.. class:: warningmark BLAST files need a "#Taxonomy" column. Sample names cannot start with a "#". All other columns in an OTU table should have a header starting with a "#".
